prompt:
Style: a texture sheet for a 3D game on a mid-1990s 32-bit home console. Sixteen square surface textures arranged in an exact 4 by 4 grid of equal squares, separated by straight, even gutters of pure black (#000000), with a pure black border around the whole sheet. Every square is filled edge to edge with one flat surface material, seen straight on (orthographic, no perspective, no objects, no frame, no vignette). The textures are made the way 32-bit console textures were made: they will be reduced to 64 by 64 pixels with a 16-colour palette each, so they need crisp, bold, readable mid-scale detail, a limited palette of about 16 colours per square, slightly gritty hand-painted detail over photographic reference, no smooth gradients, no fine noise that would vanish when reduced. Flat, even, neutral lighting: no baked-in shadows, no highlights, no light direction, no ambient occlusion at the edges (the game lights them). Each texture must tile seamlessly: the pattern continues across the left/right and top/bottom edges without seams, and the brightness is even across the square.
Row 1, left to right: (1) grey granite paving stone surface with coarse speckles and a few small yellow-grey lichen spots, no joints; (2) rough harbour fieldstone wall masonry, irregular grey and brown stones with darker mortar lines; (3) dark weathered basalt stone, near black-grey, with faint cracks; (4) weathered wooden planks running horizontally, warm brown, visible grain and a few nail heads.
Row 2: (5) dark tarred wooden planks running horizontally, almost black-brown; (6) weathered whitewashed lime plaster, off-white with faint grey stains; (7) weathered red paint on plaster, deep brick red with small scratches and chips; (8) dark blue-grey slate roof tiles in overlapping horizontal rows.
Row 3: (9) coarse twisted hemp rope fibres running diagonally, beige-brown; (10) rusty dark cast iron, dark grey with brown rust patches; (11) rugged coastal rock, grey-brown with cracks and a little moss; (12) pale beach sand with small pebbles and shell fragments.
Row 4: (13) coarse short grass and moss, muted olive green with a few brown patches; (14) dark blue-green sea water seen from above with small light ripple highlights in a loose diagonal pattern; (15) weathered white-painted wooden boat planks running horizontally with thin dark seams; (16) weathered red-painted wooden boat planks running horizontally with thin dark seams.
The materials are for a small stone fishing harbour on a fictional island in a northern sea (only the materials, not the scene).
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: square 1:1.
